subject: Action: Confirm legal name + AP contact for Nimbus Builders
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena@nimbusbuild.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@nimbusbuild.com
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood vendor setup — legal name & primary AP contact

Hi Sean,

We're getting Redwood added to our vendor master. Procurement asked me to confirm a couple of fields so their system doesn't flag the record during PO creation:

- Legal entity name (exact as appears on W-9)
- Tax classification (for US vendors)
- Primary AP contact (name + email for invoices)
- Remit address for checks (if different from headquarters)

Can you confirm those details and attach an internal W-9 or tax cert? Once we have that we'll create a supplier record and route the first PO. Also, if you have a preferred invoice template or an AP contact who handles invoice disputes, please include them.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Elena Vargas
Senior Procurement Specialist
Nimbus Builders
elena@nimbusbuild.com
procurement@nimbusbuild.com
